features.heading: Triggers in Giddh
features.subHeading: Automate customer communication through Email and WhatsApp. Set schedules for reminders, follow-ups, and notifications.

content.heading: Automate customer communication
content.description: Giddh provides a Triggers feature that allows users to automate communication with their customers through Email and WhatsApp based on predefined schedules.

content.heading: Create and configure triggers
content.description: Users can create triggers by defining when a message should be sent, who should receive it, and what content should be included in the communication. Triggers can be configured based on a specific date, time, or event requirement, ensuring timely communication without manual follow-ups.

content.heading: WhatsApp integration
content.description: For WhatsApp communication, a WhatsApp integration is required. Once integrated, users can create and schedule WhatsApp messages directly through Giddh.

content.heading: Example: payment reminder before due date
content.description: A business wants to send a payment reminder to customers three days before an invoice due date. The user can create a trigger, select the communication channel (Email or WhatsApp), define the message content, and set the schedule. Giddh will then automatically send the reminder to the respective customers at the configured time.

faqs.question: What is the Triggers feature in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Giddh provides a Triggers feature that allows users to automate communication with their customers through Email and WhatsApp based on predefined schedules.

faqs.question: What can I configure when creating a trigger?
faqs.answer: You can define when a message should be sent, who should receive it, and what content should be included. Triggers can be configured based on a specific date, time, or event requirement.

faqs.question: What communication channels are supported?
faqs.answer: Triggers support Email and WhatsApp communication.

faqs.question: What is required for WhatsApp triggers?
faqs.answer: For WhatsApp communication, a WhatsApp integration is required. Once integrated, users can create and schedule WhatsApp messages directly through Giddh.

faqs.question: What is Triggers useful for?
faqs.answer: It is especially useful for sending automated reminders, payment follow-ups, invoice notifications, and other important business communications to customers at the right time.

faqs.question: Can Triggers send payment reminders automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. For example, you can create a trigger to send a payment reminder three days before an invoice due date. Giddh will automatically send the reminder to the respective customers at the configured time.
